CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Continued public hearing from March 16, 2016 for consideration and approval of Resolution No. 2016-35 approving the Fiscal Year (FY) 2016-17 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program budget and the FY 2016-17 Annual Action Plan. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-35 approving the proposed FY 2016-17 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) budget and FY 2016-17 Action Plan; 2) Authorize the City Manager to transmit the FY 2016-17 Action Plan and execute required certifications to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); and 3) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute all funding agreements consistent with the FY 2016-17 Action Plan.
2016-04-20 Item 10A FY2016-17 Action Plan - CDBG
10B.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal regarding Case No. 15-192 CDP for the demolition of an existing residence and construction of a new single-family residence at 1084 Hermes Avenue. CASE NUMBER: 15-192 CDP; APPLICANT: Surfside Projects Hermes, LLC; APPELLANT: Victor Manneh; LOCATION: 1084 Hermes Avenue (APN 254-324-02). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Maher and Associate Planner Dichoso
Deny the appeal and adopt attached Draft City Council Resolution No. 2016-37 upholding the Planning and Building Department decision to approve and issue PBD 2016-04 (Case No. 15-192 CDP) dated February 8, 2016. Alternative options are also provided in the analysis section, of the agenda report.
2016-04-20 Item 10B Case #15-192 CDP Surfside NSFR APPEAL
10C.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's denial of a Major Use Permit, Design Review Permit, Parcel Map Waiver and Coastal Development Permit to demolish an existing mini-mart and auto-service shop and replace it with a marketplace, car wash, vacuums and an additional gas dispenser, and consolidate four existing legal lots into one lot. The project site is located within the Visitor Serving Commercial (VSC) Zone and the Coastal Zone in the community of Leucadia. CASE NUMBER: 15-018 MUP/DR/PMW/CDP; APPLICANT: S&L Oil Inc.; APPELLANT: S&L Oil Inc.; LOCATION: 865 Orpheus Avenue (APN: 256-121-29). Contact Person: Associate Planner Yentile
Uphold the appeal in part, regarding the Major Use Permit, based on findings that can be made for approval related to the car wash, vacuums, and gas pump dispenser based on evidence in the record; and, remand the project back to the Planning Commission with direction to provide recommendations on the Design Review Permit only (recognizing the concerns raised by the community and the Commission specifically related to the architecture of the building and canopy and design of the site walls) and return to City Council for final resolution on the entire project.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
